versions.changelog:
Smart Research v1.1: Adds structured research report output (summary, review, gaps, suggestions, references, follow-ups) for every query.

- New six-section report template: summary, references, review, research gaps & innovations, research suggestions, follow-up directions.
- Added templates/report-template.md and USAGE.md for standardized output and usage guidance.
- Research sessions now saved as individual Markdown files under research/sessions/.
- Workflow and rules clarified—every response is a full, citation-backed report.
- Improved instructions for crafting English search queries and using all features.

Initial release of zhiyan-smart-research.

- Enables literature search across Crossref and PubMed without dependency on external backends or WeChat.
- Integrates with OpenClaw LLM for citation-backed synthesis and structured academic reviews.
- Supports context-aware session management, including follow-up questions and memory of research topics.
- Output enforces fact citation with consistent reference formatting.
- Flexible workflows for research gaps, controversies, summaries, and discovery of academic papers.
